queries_run: FICO Fair Isaac product demand durability structural 2026 mortgage scores pricing

findings.claim: FICO 以維持批發抵押貸款分數 $10 換取貸款機構承諾；Equifax 稱 FICO 2026 價格由 $4.95 翻倍至 $10，Equifax VantageScore 4.0 定價 $4.50 至 2027 年底，TransUnion 99 美分 VantageScore 4.0 延長至 2028 年底；FHFA 擬將 VantageScore 納入同一定價表，無開始日期。
findings.source: TIKR: FICO Sinks 16% as It Holds Mortgage Score Price at $10 (搜尋摘要彙整)

findings.claim: Scores 占 FICO 2025 財年營收約 59%；6 月分析稱空頭論點取決於抵押貸款量激增中有多少為週期性而非結構性
findings.excerpt: mortgage-scoring monopoly and inviting pricing pressure. FICO's own move to a roughly $0.99-per-score-plus-fee mortgage model sharply cut average per-score fees, and investors are debating whether that defends share or signals eroding pricing power.
